description: This is a C source file implementing driver functions for the ADP5360 regulator, including configuration, voltage control, mode setting, and device initialization, specifically for Nordic Semiconductor's Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: regulator_adp5360_count_voltages
methods.description: Counts available voltage options for the regulator based on its configuration ranges.

methods.name: regulator_adp5360_list_voltage
methods.description: Lists a specific voltage value corresponding to an index.

methods.name: regulator_adp5360_set_voltage
methods.description: Sets the regulator output voltage within specified min and max microvolt range.

methods.name: regulator_adp5360_get_voltage
methods.description: Retrieves the current voltage setting of the regulator.

methods.name: regulator_adp5360_set_mode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the regulator (e.g., PWM).

methods.name: regulator_adp5360_get_mode
methods.description: Gets the current mode of the regulator.
